BC vendor partnerships · Greater Vancouver & Victoria

Vendor & Partnership Information

iHost Solutions Ltd. supports property managers, retailers, installation coordinators and facilities teams with appliance installations, minor property maintenance, cleaning and unit turnover. We provide clear work-order coordination and documentation, with each assignment reviewed for scope, availability and applicable qualifications.

Request Vendor Information

Our field operations

2 Greater Vancouver crews

Two field crews serving Greater Vancouver, including Vancouver, North Vancouver and West Vancouver. Individual work orders are accepted subject to scheduling, coverage area and scope.

1 Victoria crew

One field crew serving Victoria and surrounding areas, with confirmed scheduling and service boundaries for each assignment.

3 equipped service vans

Three service vans equipped with the professional technician tools, installation equipment and routine supplies required for supported field services.

Work-order reporting

Scope and access confirmation, relevant before-and-after photos where permitted, completion notes, applicable operating checks and escalation when site conditions differ from the quote.

Services available for vendor partnerships

Appliance installation

Dishwasher replacement, laundry equipment setup, range hoods, over-the-range microwaves and selected built-in appliance installation, subject to existing site connections, permits, licensing and insurance coverage.

Handyman & minor repairs

Furniture assembly, TV mounting, shelving, drywall patching, touch-ups and general small property repairs within our approved service scope.

Unit turnover & make-ready

Punch-list repairs, fixture condition notes, minor adjustments and documentation to assist property managers between occupancies.

Cleaning services

Residential and commercial cleaning enquiries and move-in/move-out cleaning, subject to staffing, building requirements and confirmation of the appropriate insurance coverage.

Regulated electrical, plumbing or gas work is accepted only where the appropriate trades credentials, permits and insurance apply. All services are reviewed before a work order is confirmed.

Retail & commercial work experience

Programmes and organisations we've supported

iHost has performed installation and maintenance work through service networks and direct commercial assignments. We describe the relationship accurately so procurement teams can distinguish our work history from direct vendor agreements.

Retail installation programmes

Our service-network programme access includes The Home Depot, RONA, Canadian Appliance Source (CAS), The Brick, Leon's and Best Buy. These retailer programmes are coordinated through QuickContractors.com Inc.; they are not separate direct contracts with each retailer.

Service network & commercial accounts

QuickContractors.com Inc. — contracted field-service network.
McLaren Vancouver — completed commercial property-maintenance assignments; iHost has an approved vendor record through Lithia's vendor administration.

Retailer and customer names are used descriptively to identify work experience. Listing does not imply sponsorship, endorsement or direct contractual affiliation with each named retailer.

For procurement & vendor onboarding

Company qualifications & documents

We maintain records to support supplier due diligence. Official records are shared directly with legitimate procurement teams on request so the latest document versions and any client-specific certificates can be supplied.

BC company registration

IHOST SOLUTIONS LTD. · BC incorporation number BC1569432. Registration record available on request.

Municipal business licence

District of North Vancouver · 2026 licence BUS-0285353. Our current office is Unit 232; an amendment of the previous unit number on the licence is pending.

WorkSafeBC clearance letter

Account registered. Official letter issued November 22, 2026 confirms that the first assessment payment was not yet due. The letter does not state “Good Standing.”

Liability insurance

Existing commercial general liability policy lists $2 million per occurrence. Coverage is subject to stated operations, exclusions and insurer confirmation for each requested service category.

GST registration

CRA GST account is registered. Tax registration details can be supplied through a secure vendor onboarding process.

Individual technician credential

One named installer holds an Entuitive Workforce installer approval, valid through February 24, 2027. This is an individual credential and does not certify every iHost crew.

How we work with partners

  • Review the work order, service location, access arrangements and required qualifications.
  • Confirm price, materials, scheduling and exclusions before starting.
  • Complete the agreed work and provide notes, photos and checks when appropriate.
  • Escalate unexpected conditions, follow-up requests and corrective actions through a clear contact.

We welcome enquiries about a single paid trial job, overflow work or recurring service agreements. Becoming an approved vendor does not imply a guaranteed volume of assignments.
